text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Did you see that run from Buena 
Vista...?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that was incredible...! As expected 
of a spotlight Umamusume! Looks like she's 
going to be running in major races from 
now on."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the other girls were really 
strong, weren't they? Like, way beyond 
what you'd expect for a Debut race... 
Maybe this race will become legendary—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
(Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Congrats on your debuts, everyone~! 
—Buena Vista! We're rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! I'm going to work 
super hard from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Unicalize
text_block_list.text: ...Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Unicalize
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for a great race today. —This is 
where it all begins.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Likewise! That was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: At the Crest
text_block_list.text: Haha! You really are a big shot, huh.

text_block_list.name: At the Crest
text_block_list.text:
"You're going down the Tiara route? Guess 
we won't be crossing paths for a while, 
since we're aiming for the Classic Triple 
Crown."

text_block_list.name: Shindo Runrun
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... races are always entwined with 
fate. As long as you keep running, you may 
face each other again."

text_block_list.name: Sansha Sangyo
text_block_list.text:
Sansha... Let's all make a name for 
ourselves in our own five different ways~.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And... let's run together again 
someday!

Acknowledging each other's strength, 
firing each other up, they set out on 
their respective paths... Buena Vista's 
beginning was truly refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hey, how was it? My makeup debut!
choice_data_list: Of course, it was the best!
Of course, it was the best!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Yeah, I feel on top of the world 
too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I could hear the applause of so many 
people, and see all their smiles...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If I run in even bigger races, I bet I'll 
get to see sights far more incredible than 
today's."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Buenavista-san! Congratulations on 
your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Please let me interview you! How are you 
feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Umm... ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—First of all, I'm just so happy I got to 
make my debut!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I even received words of encouragement 
right off the bat... It really fired me up 
with determination to give it my all from 
here on out!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful Make a Debut! By the 
way, regarding your future goals... Have 
you already decided on the path you wish 
to take?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going to take on the Triple Tiara 
route!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to that~~! In 
that case, the main goal for the Junior 
Class would be... the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It's a Junior-tier GⅠ race where top 
Umamusume aiming for the Tiara route 
gather! If you win here, you're guaranteed 
to shine in the Classic year too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's... Trainer-san.

With Buena Vista's level of ability, 
there's no need to play it safe. She 
should take on a GⅠ. Judging by her 
expression, she seems to have no 
objections either.
choice_data_list:
I will proceed to the "Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies."

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: —Ooh~! I knew it! —This is gonna be fun!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...Then I've got one too~. A question for 
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I hear you're... Buena Vista's childhood 
friend.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
In other words... you secured the contract 
because they saw great potential in your 
"friendship"?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard rumors about Buena Vista-san's 
immense potential. I was certain an 
experienced Trainer would be chosen for 
her, so...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you were childhood friends... And 
with him being a rookie Trainer... To be 
honest... it makes me a little suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"She's a girl with huge expectations on 
her shoulders. ...Are you sure you're up 
for this?"

"Murmurs rippled through the crowd. It was 
true that compared to the expectations 
placed upon her, my track record and 
abilities... fell short. However..."
choice_data_list:
...Please keep an eye on my work going 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'll be watching over the two of 
you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...You didn't deny it, did you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Saying we were chosen for "getting along 
well"... Even though we went through a 
proper trial contract and chose each 
other.

True, before the official contract... we 
set up a provisional trial period to 
evaluate each other's abilities—mostly 
mine. But...
choice_data_list:
It's a fact that it's "because we were 
childhood friends."

It's a fact that it's "because we were 
childhood friends."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's... true, but.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

"It is also true that the current me isn't 
enough for you." ...I swallow those words. 
There is no reason to say them. Because I 
have no intention of giving up on her.
choice_data_list: (I just need to grow until I'm worthy.)

text_block_list.text:
"It is also true that the current me isn't 
enough for you." ...I swallow those words. 
There is no reason to say them. Because I 
have no intention of giving up on her.
choice_data_list: (I just need to grow until I'm worthy.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right, I have to contact my 
mom!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
They came to cheer me on today. 
Trainer-san, do you want to come meet 
them?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Mommy—!

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Long time no see. Have you been well?"

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You hardly ever come by lately... You 
could visit more often, you know. I always 
keep your favorite sweets on hand, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Buena's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, enough of that. Congratulations 
on your debuts, you two!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"We've finally taken the first step 
together. ...I'll show you an even more 
amazing side of me!"

Toward our next target race... the Hanshin 
Juvenile Fillies, let's grow stronger 
"together."
